title: RVR-Craft
description: So much Vanilla Plus, it's not really Vanilla Plus anymore.
body:
# Welcome to RVR-Craft!

- _"What Does RVR Stand for?"_ - 
**I'm so glad you asked! RVR stands for "Ryuuji's Vanilla Reimagined!"**

- _"What sort of modpack is this?"_ - 
**This is a Vanilla +++ modpack! It adds all the features I, Ryuuji, wish were added to Vanilla Minecraft. It includes crossover mods, new mob variants, awesome new mechanics, tools, blocks, and so much more!!!**

- _"Who is this modpack for?"_ - 
**I made this modpack for my friends, and as a test to see if I could make a functional and well optimized pack.**
